mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.user_type = '00' and m.perms = #{perm}
